thread:
maria: my YAML started humming after i fixed an indent this morning. not kidding, it literally felt calmer :laughing:
aj: lol it hums the semver blues when patch numbers disappear
devon: wait what does a semver blues song sound like?
maria: like this snippet i found in my config:
```yaml
service:
  name: chorus
  version: 'v1.0-beta.0.1'  # i thought i was being creative
  tune: 'minor'
```
aj: whoa that's not semver, that's modern art. ci will cry
luis: ci-bot please weigh in
ci-bot: Build failed: invalid semver format 'v1.0-beta.0.1' — see https://semver.org for correct forms :warning:
maria: i just ran `sed 's/^v//'` and the CI applauded :tada: it stopped humming sad songs
devon: also tried adding a semicolon at the end of a YAML key like a champ. compiler responded: "unexpected token ';'". compiler has feelings now.
luis: proposal: office party — bring your whitespace. tabs optional, emotional support spaces required
aj: bring coffee not more tabs pls :coffee:
maria: also low-stakes poll: YAML that hums vs JSON that's just quietly judging you?
aj: YAML-hums here :raised_hands:
devon: json-judges-with-silence :face_with_monocle:
maria: ok consensus: we fix semver, feed the CI, and avoid semicolons in YAML. festival of whitespace tomorrow at 3pm in the lounge.
aj: i'll bring semver-themed cookies (they will be versioned) :cookie:
luis: ill bring a tiny compiler to stomp on bad versions :robot_face:
ci-bot: Reminder: next deployment checks semver strictly. Fix before 17:00 UTC.
maria: noted. singing YAML will be back on Monday if we don't. :singing_face:
